verdict.rationale: A national company registry could plausibly offer a machine channel with a documented public sandbox, so this question applies. The evidence pack contains only two robots.txt probes that returned HTTP 403 on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in. Nothing documents a sandbox or test environment for exercising a machine rail end to end, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
